name: occt-wasm
role: OpenCascade CAD kernel in WebAssembly: exact solids, STEP/STL I/O and hidden-line SVG in Node
summary: OpenCascade V8 compiled to WebAssembly with a typed TypeScript API. From one pnpm dependency, Node builds exact solids (primitives, booleans, fillets, sweeps), reads and writes STEP, STL and BREP, tessellates for three-js or babylon-js, and draws hidden-line views as SVG or PNG. It is the JavaScript route to exact CAD, with no Python.
use_when: Exact dimensioned parts and STEP I/O inside a Node or browser pipeline; over build123d when Python is unwanted
Tessellate a solid straight into a three-js or babylon-js scene
Hidden-line technical views as SVG for the svg and resvg chain
avoid_when: Python CAD scripts with a builder API: build123d
Viewing or converting CAD files with a GUI or CLI: mayo
Lighting, materials and final frames: blender-background or three-js
license: MIT OR Apache-2.0 for the wrapper and build tooling; the compiled WASM is LGPL-2.1-only (inherits OCCT), so the .wasm must stay replaceable
notes: 2026-11-27: Lead said 5.17.2; npm latest is 5.18.6 (modified 2026-11-25). Requires WASM SIMD, tail calls and wasm exceptions; no IGES. Node 22 lacks `using` syntax, so dispose the kernel by hand.

evidence.result: Filleted two-hole bracket 60x30x10 mm: volume 16917.434 mm3 equals analytic and the STEP re-import; 12 faces, 340 triangles; STL, SVG and timestamp-free STEP hashes identical across two Node 22.19.0 processes; resvg 0.47.0 PNG 1000x1046 inspected.
evidence.scope: One box, fillet, cut solid via STEP, STL and multiview SVG in Node 22, macOS arm64; not browser, workers, XCAF or glTF, sweeps or imported STEP; STEP header timestamp varies.

assessment.rationale: npm occt-wasm 5.18.6 published 2026-11-25; repository created 2026-03-26, young but releasing often. Free software (MIT OR Apache-2.0 wrapper, LGPL-2.1 WASM). Only catalogue route to exact CAD, STEP and hidden-line views from pnpm alone; build123d needs Python, mayo has no macOS build.
